gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Commanding in its plain, unshaded rods, Bellota Text leads while Chiron Sung HK follows with a faint pen-like modulation you notice only up close. The mix feels authoritative.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cinzel: Bellota Text draws every letter with one unshaded line and open, generous curves. And Cinzel, loosely tracked, brings a modest stem-to-hairline gap, so one leads with plainness and the other with polish.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-diphylleia: Diphylleia reads like a classic serif, with open apertures and bowls that swell slightly. Bellota Text sits above it with a constant pen pressure and no shading, so the two feel bookish yet bold together.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-donegal-one: Donegal One brings curves that leave plenty of daylight and thins that never turn spindly, with a slight thick-thin rhythm. Bellota Text, built from rods rather than blades, does the loud work.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fjord-one: Bellota Text has no thick-thin swing at all, just open, unshaded shapes with plenty of presence. But Fjord One, with its wide-mouthed rounds and mild contrast, would carry a long passage gently.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gentium-book-plus: Bellota Text looks bent from a single length of tubing, open and unshaded. And Gentium Book Plus, with its mellow stroke range, probably wants a slightly generous size to show its wide openings.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gfs-didot: Plain, sturdy and unshaded at the top, then something finer below. And GFS Didot, with stems a touch heavier than its crossbars, looks best given a little more size than the heading needs.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-hahmlet: Bellota Text keeps a monoline stroke from stem to serif. Hahmlet, with its soft charcoal-like pressure shadow and widely parted curves, is the one that gives the page its dignified texture.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-im-fell-english-s: Bellota Text draws a marker-like constant line with open, unshaded curves. And IM Fell English SC answers with soft, hand-inked modulation, so the pair's strongest quality is how plainly they disagree.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-inria-serif: Distinctive in its unshaded, open build, Bellota Text gives an s whose spine matches its terminals. Inria Serif softens that with a gentle heavy-to-light step; the difference is the point.
